_comment: The act layer. Acts are a COUNTER-DERIVED quest-machinery layer (progress = pure function of counters, the WIQuests idiom), evaluated by WIActs (src/core/acts.gd), NOT stored. The CURRENT act is the highest act whose predecessors' `advance_when` gates are all met (fresh boot = Act I; capped at the last act -- act_iv is open-ended until a future Act V, so ITS gate stays defined-but-unreachable for now). Conditions share one predicate shape used by both `advance_when` (advance to the next act) and per-beat `when` (journal milestone achieved): `min_classes` (int, classes.size()), `quests_completed` (int, count of COMPLETED started quests via WIQuests), `accomplishments` ({id: min_count}). Empty condition = trivially met. All copy is RESULTS-ONLY and opaque (no stats, canon-warm) per the design + repo constraint. act_ii's advance gate + its `known_face` beat key off the MONOTONIC `reached_two_classes` accomplishment (banked once the PC first holds two classes; see WIGame._bank_reached_two_classes_if_earned) rather than the live `min_classes: 2` -- a Spellsword consolidation (2 classes -> 1) must never un-advance Act II or lock Act III. `min_classes` (still supported by the predicate) is used only where it is monotone-safe (act_i's `min_classes: 1`, which the classless->first-class transition never reverses). act_iii's `raskghar_sealed` gate (previously unreachable -- there was no Act IV to advance into) now genuinely advances into act_iv, appended below (issue #89): a postgame checklist act, its beats keyed on the epilogue's own already-produced convergence counters (door_awakened + each travel region's final quest-beat id) -- pure data, no new producer.

beats.text: You've grown into a class of your own.
Liscor's gates opened for you at last.

acts.title: Make a Place for Yourself
acts.header: Act II -- Make a Place for Yourself

beats.text: Word of your errands is getting around town.
Krshia trusts you with more than gossip now.
The Watch knows to call on you when something's wrong.
Liscor is starting to know your face.
Something is moving in the dark beneath the city.
The seal holds. Liscor counts you among its own.

acts._comment: Issue #89 (gap-2, narrative payoff): the postgame act. Its beats are the epilogue's own already-shipped convergence counters -- door_awakened (the Magical Door chain) + the final report-beat accomplishment of each of the four travel regions' quest chains (quests.json: price_of_a_favor/report, a_gentlemans_disagreement/report, forge_tier_permit/stamped [the deeper of the two Pallass quests], what_the_seal_kept/report) -- so the journal's act line finally reflects the postgame content act_iii's own epilogue fires ahead of. `advance_when` mirrors the SAME five ids as a defined-but-unreachable placeholder for a future Act V (never evaluated while act_iv is last, exactly act_iii's own pre-#89 shape).
acts.title: What the Door Opened
acts.header: Act IV -- What the Door Opened

beats.text: The pantry door remembers being elsewhere again, and somewhere else remembers it back.
Riverfarm's fields breathe easier, and a witch in the hollow no longer collects on the village's fear.
A merchant's name is settled in Invrisil, one way or another, and the Brothers remember who settled it.
The forge tier of Pallass stands open above you now, papers stamped and the lift unlocked.
The Horns of Hammerad have taken a corner of the inn as their own, and the seal beneath Liscor holds quiet.
